description: Erection of a single storey rear infill extension and rear extension to rear outrigger.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (003; 004  Received:  29 July 2021;  001; 002; 005  Received:  07 July 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - No additional windows, doors or other glazed openings shall be formed in the single storey rear infill extension and rear extension hereby approved.

Condition : 5 - The additional first floor side window of the original house hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, non-openable below 1.75 metres above finished floor level and be permanently retained as such.
